name: heart_piercer_bow_equipped_attacker_pings_defenders_creature
notes: Printed: 'Whenever equipped creature attacks, this Equipment deals 1 damage to target creature defending player controls. Equip {1}'. Equip {1} on P0's turn attaches the Bow to the Bear (the one colorless is spent). The Bear attacks; the trigger's target is P1's Opp B (P1's creatures are the legal targets; P0's Bear Two is not, see the twin): Opp B has 1 damage, Opp A none, and the unblocked Bear deals 2 to P1.
